highlights: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Smart Fitness Watch  - Global Version
Color Band 10: Midnight Black, Glacier Silver, Mystic Rose
Display Size and Type  1.72-inch AMOLED Touch Display
Screen Brightness   HBM 1500 nits with auto brightness adjustment
Sensors   Accelerometer   Gyroscope   Electronic compass   Optical heart rate and pulse oximeter   Ambient light sensor
Water-resistant to 50m: Based on the ISO 22810 First edition: 2010 test standard, the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 has been certified water-resistant by TÜV SÜD.
Water resistance rating report number: 68.189.24.0798.01. Rated 5ATM water-resistant (equivalent to a submersed depth of 50 metres).
This means it can be worn in swimming pools, while swimming near the shore and during other shallow water activities.
